record_title: Positive characteristic collapses the two-call passive register frontier
provenance: Classifies exactly the polynomials computable by two-register passive-output programs with at most two input accesses, and derives an unbounded positive-characteristic degree frontier from Frobenius/additive polynomials.
limitations: The exact iff classification is for one work register plus one passive output and at most two input accesses. The construction is univariate and commutative. Over finite fields, degree of a polynomial function is representation-dependent; the stated construction is a formal polynomial identity. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with material folklore and near-simultaneous priority risk.
